articles.title: Hong Kong Launches Crackdown on Illegal Wildlife Feeding Starting Today
articles.summary: Hong Kong's Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) has kicked off a special one-month operation today, October 1, to tackle the problem of people illegally feeding wild animals. Officers will patrol multiple known hotspots across the city where this behaviour is most common. Feeding wild animals is against the law in Hong Kong because it can make animals too dependent on humans, spread disease, and disrupt natural habits. Anyone caught breaking the rules may face a fine. The AFCD hopes the campaign will remind the public to enjoy wildlife responsibly and from a safe distance, protecting both animals and people.

lv1: What government department is leading the new operation against illegal wildlife feeding? (哪個政府部門負責今次打擊非法餵飼野生動物的行動？)
How long will this special enforcement operation last? (今次特別執法行動為期多長時間？)
lv2: Why is it harmful to feed wild animals, even if people do it out of kindness? (為甚麼餵飼野生動物有害，即使人們出於好意？)
Why do you think the authorities chose to launch this operation on October 1? (你認為當局為何選擇在十月一日展開這個行動？)
lv3: Some people argue that feeding stray or wild animals shows compassion, while others say it causes long-term harm. Which view do you agree with more, and why? (有人認為餵飼野生動物是出於愛心，但也有人認為這會造成長遠傷害。你較認同哪個觀點？為甚麼？)
Should the government focus more on educating the public or on strict enforcement to protect wildlife? What are the strengths and weaknesses of each approach? (政府應更着重公眾教育還是嚴格執法來保護野生動物？兩種方式各有甚麼優缺點？)

articles.title: Deadly Floods Hit Bangkok, Leaving Streets Underwater and Thousands Displaced
articles.summary: The Thai capital Bangkok has been struck by severe flooding caused by extremely heavy rainfall, resulting in at least eight deaths and affecting more than 1.7 million households. Floodwaters turned roads into rivers, with some residents using boats to travel through their neighbourhoods and collect daily supplies. The disaster has caused enormous damage estimated at over 300 million US dollars. Emergency services have been working hard to help those who are stranded. The flooding highlights the growing threat of extreme weather events in Southeast Asia, where rapid urban development and climate change are making cities more vulnerable to major storms and heavy rain.

lv1: How many people lost their lives in the Bangkok flooding? (曼谷水災造成多少人死亡？)
What did some residents use to travel through the flooded streets? (部分居民用甚麼方法在水浸街道上出行？)
lv2: Why might cities like Bangkok be especially at risk from severe flooding compared to rural areas? (與農村地區相比，為甚麼像曼谷這樣的城市特別容易受到嚴重水災的影響？)
How can extreme weather events like this affect not only people's safety but also their daily lives and the economy? (這類極端天氣事件除了影響人身安全外，還會如何影響人們的日常生活及經濟？)
lv3: Some experts say that rapid urban development in Southeast Asia is making floods worse. Do you agree? What could city planners do differently to reduce flood risks? (部分專家指東南亞快速城市發展令洪災更嚴重。你是否認同？城市規劃者可以如何改變做法以減低洪災風險？)

When a disaster like this happens in another country, what responsibilities, if any, do other nations and international organisations have to help? Should wealthier countries do more? (當其他國家發生這類災難時，其他國家和國際組織有甚麼責任提供幫助？富裕國家是否應該做得更多？)

articles.title: 國慶黃金周｜港鐵送出7.7萬張車票　電車天星小輪免費乘坐
articles.summary: 為慶祝中華人民共和國成立77周年，香港多個交通機構及文娛設施於十月一日起推出各項優惠。港鐵透過MTR Mobile應用程式抽出共7.7萬張免費車票送給市民，電車及天星小輪亦全日免費乘搭。除此之外，戲院半價優惠、昂坪360纜車來回票半價、馬場及濕地公園亦免費開放。當局預計國慶黃金周期間（10月1日至7日）約有744萬人次進出香港，反映訪港旅客需求旺盛。

lv1: 港鐵今日透過哪個應用程式抽出免費車票？
國慶黃金周共有多少天？
lv2: 為甚麼政府和商界在國慶日提供各種優惠和免費活動？
大量旅客在黃金周期間訪港，對香港市民的日常生活有甚麼影響？
lv3: 政府和商界以優惠活動慶祝國慶，有人認為這能增強市民的國家認同感，但也有人認為這只是商業推廣。你認為哪個看法更合理？
香港作為國際城市，每逢節假日都吸引大批旅客，這對香港的文化和環境帶來甚麼機遇和挑戰？

articles.title: 大熊貓「平平」與「福雙」啟程赴美　落戶亞特蘭大動物園展開十年旅居
articles.summary: 來自成都的兩隻大熊貓「平平」和「福雙」已正式啟程，前往美國喬治亞州亞特蘭大動物園，展開為期十年的旅居生活。此行是中國國家主席習近平早前訪美期間宣布的「熊貓外交」安排的一部分。大熊貓是中國的國寶，在全球深受喜愛，牠們的抵美備受當地民眾期待。這次安排不但有助推動中美兩國的文化交流，也希望透過展覽提高公眾對大熊貓保育的關注。

lv1: 兩隻大熊貓將前往美國哪個城市的動物園居住？
這兩隻大熊貓的名字是甚麼？
lv2: 為甚麼大熊貓常被用作「外交禮物」來促進國與國之間的關係？
大熊貓在動物園展出，對牠們的保育工作有甚麼好處和壞處？
lv3: 「熊貓外交」是否真的能改善兩國之間的關係，還是只是一種象徵性的姿態？請從不同角度分析。
有人認為珍稀動物應該留在原產地自然保育區，而非送往外國動物園展覽。你同意嗎？為甚麼？
